reasoning: Base ratings: the Trail Blazers are +3.1 and the Thunder +8.8 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Thunder 1.8 better here, total 223.
Rest, travel and availability barely move it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Thunder by 1.9, 56% to win; total 221 (80% range 197-245).
